body: Incredibly beautiful area combined with a fine guide and skipper!
title: Nature rest

body: Magical experience! The hosts were warm, friendly, knowledgeable, and great with kids. We saw some amazing birds but to be honest I’d happily pay the same to float around the lagoon just listening to the birds song and the waves in the background. Utter bliss! My 6 year old gave it a million out of 10 which says it all really! Thoroughly recommend.
title: Magical experience!

body: Amazing!! Such a wonderful trip and would highly recommend. It was so peaceful listening to the bird song and such stunning scenery. The staff were fantastic, really knowledgeable and friendly and went above and beyond to make our experience just perfect. Just do it, you won’t regret it!
title: A must do!

body: This is our fourth water based eco bird watching tour with Buddhi in Kalametiya Bird Sanctuary.Not only does he has incredible wildlife expertise and knowledge he has lived in close proximity to the sanctuary all his life so it is in his DNA.This time with increased tourist numbers when we arrived at 0600 hrs for sunrise safari there were already groups awaiting embarkation.Prevoius safaris we were alone.It is important to note the are arranged tours by companies and the guides are part of the company and may not even be locals with intrinsic knowledge.Buddhi is and has always remained an independent operator so you have a much more close knit experience with at other clients unbeknown to you.We were fortunate to see a diverse range of birds during our two hour safari and assisted ably by surveillance skills of BuddhiAs the lagoon is shallow with in places excessive vegetation the only option is eco non motorised boat with an oar
title: Amazing Buddhi

body: Our tuk tuk driver recommended us this excursion, he rang his friend and booked it and we had the best time. It was beautiful and calm and there were lots of amazing birds. The guide identified them for us, and we got to climb a big rock to see the view of the wetlands.
title: Beautiful birds

body: I'm shocked that this doesn't show up on the list of top things to do in Sri Lanka. What a magical experience!!!I only booked the day before and managed to get a 6am tour, which was the recommended time to see the most birds. The manager also booked a tuktuk to pick me up and drop me off from my hostel for an additional fee.My guide, Meneka, was so knowledgeable and I was in awe at how she spotted so many birds without even using binoculars. It was amazing to see kingfishers, pelicans, darts, bee-eaters, swamp hens and so many more. I'm sure we saw close to 50 varieties, although at the end Meneka apologised that we didn't see that many!! So I can't even imagine how fulfilling it would be on an even better day.Meneka also brought me homemade Sri Lankan kokis, and bananas, as a snack. The tuktuk driver they hired, Titus, was also really friendly and stopped on the way back to show me his favourite spots and recommendations.This experience is an absolute must if you're staying anywhere near Kalametiya - don't miss it!
title: Magical experience

body: An incredibly peaceful and magical place. At sunrise beautiful scenery, colorful birdlife, great dedicated boat crew (guide and rower) and the surf of the sea in your ear. The boats are great, they glide quietly and leisurely over the mirror-smooth water. Definitely worth a trip😍
title: Magical start to the day

body: Brilliant knowledge of habitats, birds, bats and weather systems. Amazing experience with friendly guides. Binoculars provided which was a bonus.
title: A must do activity in Sri Lanka

body: It was a wonderful experience. The landscape is breathtaking and the silence almost meditative. My two companions, guide Singhe and boatman LasanthaMy were super nice and I had a lot of fun and a great time.
title: A great tour

body: It was a really great tour, thanks to our professional guide Buddhi with a lot of humor, I enjoyed it! My recommendation.
title: Great bird experience 😉

body: Buddih did an amazing Job. We saw many birds and had a great time on the boat. we had binoculars and books to identify the birds. be sure to wear a hat as it gets hot towards the end with the sun. buddih also made us water lily necklaces, we had a lot of fun.
title: Bird Watching

body: I enjoyed my tour ! Buddhi is a great guide ! Always smiling and very pedagogue. Not easy sometimes to see certain birds but he always do the best to have the possibility to do it . He’s very patient and friendly . I recommend him ! Beautiful experience .
title: Beautiful moment

body: Our bird-watching expedition in Kalametiya stands out as the highlight of our journey in Sri Lanka. Buddika, our guide, alongside the boat captain, showcased an impressive depth of knowledge about the diverse bird species inhabiting the area. Their respect for nature and wildlife was palpable, enhancing the authenticity of our experience. Their thoughtful provision of water bottles and willingness to cater to individual preferences, like our request to spot a kingfisher, truly personalized our adventure. They skillfully captured stunning photographs and videos, enriching our memories. The exploration was further augmented by intriguing insights into local flora. Their dedication to exceeding expectations transformed our trip into a remarkable adventure. I heartily recommend this experience to anyone with a passion for nature and wildlife.
title: Exceptional Service and Natural Wonders

body: We spent a very good time, my 10 years old daughter was very excited, the guide was polite and erudite. I recommend this tour to everyone . Thank you very much for this beautiful day!
title: Excellent tour!

body: We had such a wonderful start to our day visiting the Kalametiya bird sanctuary! Seeing the sun rise in such beautiful surroundings was just amazing! I don’t know a lot about birds but feel so informed after several hours of expert information from our guide Buddhi. It was truly one of the highlights of our trip to Sri Lanka.
title: Amazing experience

body: Kalametiya Bird sanctuary is a one of oldest and main sanctuary in Srilanka. Kalametiya bird sanctuary records species of birds. The bird sanctuary is situated in Hambantota district, approximately 20 Kms away from the Tangalle city. The best times to visit this area is 6:00 am and 3:30 pm and also i advised the same timings.
title: The best times to visit this area is 6:00 am and 3:30 pm and also i advised the same timings

body: A late afternoon / early evening trip around the Kalametiya Bird Sanctuary was such a beautiful experience. The calm manner of our guide Priyankara and Gayan, who steered our paddle boat effortlessly, made for such a serene trip around this beautiful sanctuary. Priyankara was knowledgeable and eagle eyed. We saw more than 20 species of birds and buffalo swimming too! The sanctuary is serene and we were lucky enough to see the sunset as well. I can't recommend this trip highly enough. I would do it again in a heartbeat ❤️
title: Absolutely stunning experience in the most tranquil setting!

body: To do ! The place is magnificent, very peaceful. Buddhi teaches us a lot about the birds we come across. He provides the binoculars, is very smiling, takes the time to take photos and videos while we observe. I recommend without hesitation! One of the best activities of our stay!
title: Father/Daughter Birdwatching

body: Buddhi is an excellent guide, passionate about birds and nature. He explained to us all the species we encountered, took great photos for us and made the experience great. We highly recommend it. Thank you very much Buddhi!
title: A great experience

body: An excellent time- we enjoyed the beautiful tranquility together with the excellent knowledge and care of the team. We saw a good range of birds but most of all a relaxing experience all round
title: Well worth a visit - tranquil and relaxing in a wonderful natural environment

body: Thanks to Buddhi, who is very knowledgeable guide and bird enthusiast we had really amazing and pieceful trip, saw a lot and also felt like we are alone. Good activity if you are running away from tourist flocks.
title: Tranquility and wonderful experience near Tangalle

body: I had the worst conditions : cloudy and then rainy... in consequence it was difficult to see all it had been possible to see in a sunny morning.But Buddhi made my tour an enjoyment.First, while he knows so much about the birds of the place - and not only (species, habbits environment ...), and then while he likes to explain, show and share. Finally, he has incredible eyes, which made me discover a lot if birds I had not seen by myself.Thank you so much for that "out of time" moment.
title: moment suspended out of time

body: We had a great time with Buddhi our guide. The landscape is magnificent, the explanations are clear and we were lucky enough to also see a crocodile. We loved this moment and it will be one of the highlights of our trip. Thank you for all.
title: Amazing moment

body: The tour is a must do for nature/bird lovers. The guide has good knowledge and spotted the birds very well. We were to use good binoculars for birdwatching while our skipper moved our boat gentle and smoothly through the water.The lagoon is peaceful, quiet and is of breathtaking beauty. There were many birds and water buffalo, monkeys, bats.The guide is really passionate about the lagoon and the birds.At the end of the tour the guide invited us to do a short meditation, it was so calming . Visiting this sanctuary is highly recommended
title: Ultimate calming birdwatching paradise

body: Our guide, Buddhi is an amazing guide! Before we had departed on our trip 10 minutes, he had pointed out 10 different species. Our group appreciated that no motors are allowed in the sanctuary and the catamaran moves quietly through the water via an oarsman with a bamboo pole.
title: Birders Paradise

body: Buddhi was our guide for the most magical bird watching tour we could have imagined. We saw 38 different bird species, plus frogs, water buffalo, flying foxes and monkeys! Buddhi is incredibly knowledgeable and a true environmentalist who is so passionate about wildlife and shares this wonderfully on the tour. It is such a peaceful experience without using a motor boat, and the area is a true biodiversity hotspot. Doing the afternoon tour and catching the sunset is an added bonus! I would recommend Buddhi to anyone!!
title: The most magical nature experience with the best guide!!

body: We loved taking this tour with Buddhi, he was a passionate guy with tones of knowledge of the birds in Sri Lanka. Within the first 5 minutes we already saw a handful of new and colourful species, including various species of kingfisher. Would recommend to anybody!
title: Beautiful and informative tour

body: Unforgettable excursion:The most beautiful reserveDiverse and amazing flora and faunaI especially liked the birdsongMany thanks to our guide, a real ornithologist and professional photographer!It was very interesting!It's obvious that he loves his job.We recommend it to everyone.
title: Bird paradise

body: Awesome tour! So many birds, calmness, adventure and meditation all in one! We enjoyed it so much and will definitely do it again! Thank you
title: Best tour

body: This is our third boat tour over a number of years at Kalametiya Bird Sanctuary with Buddhi.He has an absolutely delightful infectious and fun personality.He is a passionate environmentalist and has respect for the fragile ecosystem where he operates his tours.He takes you along a magic journey where his ability to spot birds and with his encyclopaediac knowledge describe them in detail holds your attention.Obviously the last few years have been tough for guides like Buddhi who in spite of the challenges remains firmly positive and we must cherish his expertise You are a very special person Buddhi and such a model to your generation as your character personality principles and respect for those you engage with ticks all the boxes
title: Buddhi you are a star

body: If you enjoy spending time in an unspoiled natural outdoor setting where you feel like you are the only human soul for miles around, be sure to put Kalametiya Bird Sanctuary on the itinerary for your next visit to southern Sri Lanka - and absolutely hire Buddhi as your guide. We did, and the morning we spent on the lagoon with him and the able pilot of our little catamaran (which is piled through the lagoon’s winding channels - no motors around …) was the highlight of our trip! We aren’t birders, per se, but Buddhi’s passion for the birds of Kalametiya is infectious. Never have we had a more engaging, entertaining guide on such an outing - and we have been on many. And while his birding knowledge and skills are first rate, he has also mastered a local type of flute (he serenaded us with a couple of songs during our safari), he can turn lotus flowers into necklaces, and he’ll amaze you with magical tricks. And be sure to give him your phone if your photographic skills leave something to be desired - Buddhi will make you look like a National Geographic photographer with the photos and incredible videos he takes! We did a morning excursion and will remember the sunrise from the top of a large granite boulder offering views over the entire lagoon for a long time to come. It was a truly wonderful morning that we couldn’t recommend more highly …
title: A morning on the lagoon with Buddhi is one you will not forget …

body: Buddhi was the best guide ever. Very knowledgeable and goes above and beyond to make this experience unforgettable. I enjoyed the calming boat ride along the lagoon, surrounded by bird calls and peaceful serenity early morning. We also did a small hike up a rock to get a 360 degree breathtaking view of the lagoon. Apart from sharing his knowledge on birds, nature and the lagoon, Buddhi entertained us with his beautiful flute tunes and making necklaces out of water lillies. I would recommend Buddhi his small business called Kalametiya eco bird watching to anyone who loves an unforgettable bird watching tour.
title: Best bird watching trip ever

body: very nice guide with a great sense of humor. I would call it a bird safari. we had a great time for a good price. we saw rare birds, their nests are made of cobwebs 😮😮. even a monkey was lucky enough to see. we called for rain by playing the flute. it was a good experience in our journey! thanks Buddy 💛
title: Exciting journey 🤩

body: The atmosphere is very quiet and it s very easy to see many birds.The staff is nice and provide a lot of information regarding the wildlife. 😁
title: Peaceful and friendly moment 😃

body: Great experience! Buddi is a knowledgeable, and above all, passionate guide. We did the sunrise tour with a lovely meditation on a rock (a little detour) and continued to peddle through the lagoon. Highly recommend him as a guide for a truly unique birdwatching experience ✨
title: A truly unique birdwatching experience

body: The excursion was really good. The guide is super nice and the birds and landscape are incredible. Very good option if you are in the south area of the country, definitely recommended!

The tour has a few surprises as well.
title: One of the best birding experiences I ever had in Sri Lanka !

body: We did an early morning tour, leaving at 6am. The early start was well worth it, to enjoy the tranquility of the waters and the amazing array of birdlife'Gayan provides binoculars and drinking water. He shares his great knowledge of the birdlife of the area, and points out the different species that can be seen.Highlights for us were a close view of a spoonbill, and a glimpse of a yellow bittern.We also enjoyed a snack of bananas and biscuits, made by Gayan's mother.It's worth having a sun hat and sun cream.
title: Glide through the waters for peace and birdwatching

body: Excellent guide with a passion for birds and people! Deep knowledge on local flora and fauna + perfect English! We came by to his house by accident, was told about his tours - this one is a must have in your agenda 😁
title: Birdwatching adventures

body: Had read about this place, booked a 4pm tour and travelled over from the Anantara with two kids aged 8 and 11.So glad we did. Gayan was our guide and took us out with a boatman on a little catamaran. Was a bit unsure at first that it would get boring for the kids but they loved it. Binoculars supplied for all and Gayan was patient with our complete lack of bird knowledge.Was amazing soaking up the atmosphere especially as sunset approached. Saw an incredible number of amazing bird life plus buffalo wandering in the mangrove. Whole place exuded zen and we left feeling we’d seen something very special. An incredible visit and very good value too ($45 for the whole family for 2.5 hrs).
title: What a stunning afternoon

body: We would highly recommend this charming boat ride spotting some of Sri Lanka’s native bird species. Our guide was able to spot the birds from a huge distance and we then searched with binoculars. Lots to see in a very beautiful setting.
title: Beautiful birds

body: Thoroughly enjoyed our trip on the lagoon. We had a most knowledgeable and kind guide with an expert boatman who navigated his way skillfully through all the water lilies. I was so beautiful, we went twice and would have gone again if we had time.
title: Wonderful trip

body: Amazing experience with Buddhi. We had no expectation and what a great time we spend on bird watching. Buddhi is great man with a shiny smile who gave us so many information about bird spieces. And also he had a surprise for us 😍 highly recommended
title: Amazing experience

He explained a bit about every bird species we saw. You also get the binoculars and he has a book where he can show you a bit more about the birds. He even played us a song, lovely!
title: Amazing nature, birds and guide!

body: The trip was amazing! The guide was very nice friendly and knowledgable. We saw a lot of bird species and learned a lot about them. The lagoon itself is lovely, the ride was very peaceful. The communication with guide was easy and fast. He speaks English better than most Sri Lankans. Highly recommended 🙂
title: Great nature and bird watching trip

body: It was a beautiful tour, at sunrise, in a real natural paradise ..... My guide, Gayan, whom I recommend to everyone with all my heart, was a great help to me, because he is a very good local wildlife-birds specialist. It was something like a dream, something I will never forget for the rest of my life....
title: Just Amazing.............

body: Our guide Buddhi was extremely knowledgeable and had an eagle eye when it came to spotting the birds. He provided binoculars and books to show us the species we saw from afar, and along the way he even treated us to some flute-playing! It was a thoroughly relaxing and enjoyable experience, and seeing the sun rise over the reserve was just beautiful.
title: Magical experience seeing over 20 bird species!

body: We had a wonderful time in Kalametiya bird sanctuary with our local guide Buddhi. We boated around the area and saw 40 species of birds in just one evening! The whole trip was perfectly and professionally organized. The meetup point was easy to find, and we were supplied with binoculars and bird field guides upon arrival. Buddhi was very good at spotting and identifying birds and shared a lot of interesting information about each kind. Near sunset, we were taken up to a large rock with a stunning view of the sanctuary and all of its roosting birds. Towards the end of the tour, we were even given a little checklist to count and remember the species we saw. My favourite sightings were the pied kingfishers, pheasant-tailed jacanas and black-winged stilts. Overall, we really enjoyed the tour and got some great photographs out of it as well. I highly recommend this unique experience to anyone touring the southern province.
title: Best Birdwatching Experience !

body: I must say the enthusiastic guide was the best part of our journey. Buddhi is a young man from the locality who is clearly passionate about what he is doing. He went to extra lengths to make the experience more memorable for us. From the time we called him, sending us the WhatsApp location and keeping in touch. He has some surprises lined up along the way as well (I shall not spoil them for you ;-)The Wet Land Park is clearly underrated and not known to enough people. Ornithologists and amateurs alike will love this place. The Park is just two hours away from Colombo on the highway and fully worth the visit if you are into nature. Plus you will be supporting a young man and his team to earn a living doing what they are good at (which was the bonus point for me)You will be pleasantly surprised with this experience especially considering the geography of the area :-)Tips:1. The season and the weather will both contribute to what you see and how many species you see. We were advised that the morning boat ride is better but we had our time limitations so we took the evening ride anyway. There was a storm brewing but still we managed some decent sightings but also learnt a lot from this knowledgeable young man. The boat man was equally accommodating of our requests to slow down. 2. You will have a better chance of contacting Buddhi via WhatsApp because the local telephone networks are pretty lousy in the area. His number is +94 71 355 79253. Take water with you - but leave no plastic behind. A snack would be also good ;-)
title: A peaceful long boat ride on a calm lagoon, with a few surprises along the way :-)

body: I have been living in Sri Lanka for past few years and only recently heard about Kalametiya Eco bird sanctuary. My wife and myself decided to go on an evening tour. We met up with Buddhi our guide at the reserve and he was very professional and a fountain of knowledge on the ecosystem and all creatures within. He was expertly equipped and provided binoculars and beautiful illustrated guide books and could identify all the different types of birds instantly. During our fantastic three hour experience we identified 42 different species of birds. I cannot recommend Kalamatiya Eco bird tours enough and it is definitely one thing you need to put on your to do list while visiting Sri Lanka and I certainly hope to get back to do the
title: Fantastic experience. Hugely recommended

body: I and my wife, who are Sri Lankans, were visiting Hambanthota area over Christmas holidays and suddenly decided to visit Kalametiya sanctuary where we met Buddhi. We have not had any prior knowledge and this was our first bird watching experience. Buddhi and his colleague were very professional, organized and knowledgeable. They showed us and described many species of birds (we saw 3 types of eagles as well). Buddhi is talented and could spot a bird from a far distance and he could even identify a bird from its cry from a distance. We went in the morning starting the boat ride around 7 am. Including the stop over at the rock (to see the panoramic view of the lagoon), the entire bird watching trip was more than 3 hours. We highly recommend this. A trip to Hambanthota area is not complete without this activity.
title: Great experience. Professional service by Buddhi

body: A must go tour in Sri Lanka 💚Buddi & his team is professional and keen to give the traveller the unique experience which is far more valuable for the money that you spend.Suggest to start early in the morning.
title: Superb 💚

body: First, I have to admit I went 2 times during my stay here. It was the absolute best way to start the day surrounded by nature and beauty. Buddhi was our guide both times and makes the experience 5-stars. I almost didn't want to do a review because it's such a magical place it would be sad to see it spoilt with many people, As of now there was just one other boat on the water besides ours, both times. Buddhi can spot a bird so far away it's a true talent, and with the binoculars they lend out you can really enjoy the scenery. Go for the sunrise, it's early but absolutely stunning.
title: Amazing way to start the day

body: Despite the very early start of the bird watching tour (before sunrise), it is worth it. Beautiful landscapes and a variety of birds are amazing. Buddhi the guide is a true enthusiast in his field, a devoted and knowledgeable ornithologist and an excellent storyteller. He is verycommunicative and accurate in contacts by phone and email.His reference books of birds and binoculars helped a lot.After the tour, Buddhi sent us many pictures of ours against the background of the beautiful Sri Lankan nature, made by him on his own initiative. The float-boat drivenby a man with a pole is equipped with comfortable seats and is safe for excursions with children.
title: An amazing experiense

body: If you like watching birds, you have to book at guided tour at Kalametiya. Our guide, Buddhi, was positive and enthusiastic all the way through. We saw a lot of beautiful birds in their natural surroundings. It was a 5 star experience.
title: 5 star experience

body: My wife and I were very impressed by this Wetlands Lagoon at Tangalle - where Buddhi and Hasim from Kalametiya Eco Bird Watching poled us along on a raft type wooden boat. This meant we were able to quietly approach islands and reed beds without disturbing birds and had some lovely close up views. With Buddhi’s help and knowledge we identified 64 different bird species during our 2-3 hour visit there which was a lovely quiet interlude. This quiet and peaceful method of boating around the wetlands, as no motor boats are allowed, ensures that the abundance of the bird and amphibian species found there is not over disturbed, for the benefit of both the wildlife and tourists.
title: An amazing tranquil wetland lagoon with a huge number of bird species and a great guide.

body: We were picked up by our very courteous driver in a tuk tuk very early at 6.15 am and this proved to be a great start to the day ! It was so relaxing 😎 a wanted to have a douse being amidst the sounds of nature gently travelling along the lagoon with our guides, who were so nice and informative . Also dab hand on the Samsung taking pictures and playing his flute while informing us about all the different birds we could see with or without binoculars!Thank you so much 😊
title: a absolute must ! 😀

body: Smooth pickup and a good driver. At the lagoon we were met by the excellent guide Buddhi and his co sailor. They took us out on the beautiful lagoon in a paddle boat and showed us 32 different birds, apes and a gang of buffaloes taking a bath...what a treat! And as a perfect ending of the day we climbed up a rock and watched the amazing sunset. Highly recommended!
title: Very special experience!

body: My husband and I are not really avid bird watchers but we enjoyed this trip all the same as the nature is really beautiful. It is not a well known touristy area which adds to the appeal. He also took some great photos with my camera. An enjoyable experience.
title: Peaceful

body: Very gentle paddle through the lagoon, spotting birds in their habitat. Our guide provided us with fruit. He was very attuned to nature and the need for conservation. His English was very good and his attitude was serene and friendly. Highly recommended
title: Excellent trip

body: It was firstly a beautiful experience to watch the sun rise over the lagoon at Kalametiya and to be in complete peace apart from the sounds of wild birds waking up to the day.Buddhi was a charming and a very knowledgeable guide with extraordinary eyesight for even the tiniest of birds. He made the trip fascinating and fun. Climbing up the big boulders to get a better look at the lagoon was challenging but well worthwhile because the view was wonderful!We must have seen around 20 different tropical birds in the 3 hours we were out on the lagoon. It was an unforgettable experience, thank you Buddhi. We would recommend this trip to any nature lover and particularly to bird enthusiasts!

body: We’ve had a really good time with a very experienced guide who made our 2h tour a great experience! We recommend it 100%. Nice view, beautiful birds, peaceful environment, and lots of laugh with both the guide and the captain. I won’t say more but the guide has some surprises prepared for you that will make you spend a memorable moment! Thank you!! 😍

body: This birdwatching tour through the mangroves was one of our favourite things that we did in Sri Lanka. It was so peaceful and magical being immersed in this beautiful natural environment.Buddhi was great as well as giving us so much information, he entertained the kids with lily necklaces, flute playing and yummy coconut biscuits.At the end of the tour we climbed the rock to watch the sunset from - absolutely perfect!(Kids aged 6 and 9years)
title: Magical

body: Great way of spending morning in a peaceful way. You can enjoy watching many different birds and other species and relax listening to the calm sound of nature. Crew is friendly and knowledgeable. Highly recommended
title: Peaceful and relaxing morning

body: We did this trip with Buddhi and neither of us are serious spotters we just went along because of the landscape. There’s no litter and better still no jeeps all around you. Just peace, birdsong and a beautiful location. Thanks Buddhi..
