body: We spent great time with Kalametiya bird watching. Buddhi (the owner) is very friendly, sensitive to people, excellent knows the local birds (there are very many of them), with a great sense of humor. interesting and not boring guy. The park itself is full of all kinds of birds. we got great pleasure to spend time there.
title: Great time in Kalametiya bird watching

body: I can recommend this birding excursion. I called Buddhi on his cell phone and he managed to fit us in early the next morning. He was punctual, and very knowledgeable about the bird species on and around the lagoon. It was a very pleasant and informative experience. He really cares about, and looks after his customers. He seems to be a good photographer as well. (Have a look at the photos on his web site.) He unobtrusively took photos and video clips during the tour of the lagoon, and by the time we said goodbye he had it already compiled into a short video which he sent to us. I would definitely do this again if I ever have a chance.
title: A great morning

body: Hats off to the persistence of Buddhi. He is great at his knowledge about birds. Not only that he is awesome at delighting his customers. Every small things is meticulously planned. He had called us at 3.30pm we reached slightly early 30 mins. So he gave us a welcome drink, as coconut water which was refreshing. He took us to every small places in the lagoon where there was a possibility to see birds. This made us aware about the various birds. He continously took efforts to show birds to us. We saw 40 odd species of birds. He spent more than 3 hours with us his company was a delight. He was always smiling face. Resolved all our queries. Plus shared more and more information about different birds and the minute differences between the male n female birds and with long beaks n short beaks. Colors on the birds and why every thing in the nature is well planned by the almighty. He took us on the rock where we could see the 350 degree view of the lagoon. He and his friend helped us to climb and get down the rock easily. He supported and motivated us at every point in the journey of that three hours. He made our day a life time experience for us which we'll cherish for the years ahead. By the end of the journey he had a video ready with background music for us of all our journey during the 3 hours we spent. Again very very highly appreciated and recommended guy for bird watching at Kalametiya Bird sanctuary. Thank you Buddhi and thank you to your friend who took all the hard work for driving the ⛵. RegardsKedar and Kamini
title: Buddhi is Superb at Customer Delight and Bird knoweledge

body: We highly recommend a trip with Buddhi. The boat trip was such a relaxing way to experience this lagoon and see some beautiful wildlife. Buddhi was a perfect guide, amazingly knowledgable and so friendly. He made us a lovely video of the trip and was brilliant with our toddler. Not only did we see an abundance of different bird species but also monkeys and water buffalo. Even if your not overly interested in birds, this is a must experience :)
title: A perfect afternoon

body: Buddhi was a great guide, he was friendly and wanted to make sure that everything was well organised for us. The flute at the end was magical and added a whole other dimension to the experience. I was a little disappointed by the variety of birds that we got to witness but I suppose this was out of his control!
title: Father and daughter

body: It is hard to explain how great it was, without giving too much spoilers of the great surprises that await you. We saw the option of the Kalametiya Bird Watching tour at our hotel and decided late night (9 pm) we would like to go the next morning (6:30 am). That was not a problem. The hotel arranged transport and at Kalametiya we were surprised we had a private tour guide. An enthusiastic young gentleman named Bhuddi guided us onboard the raft, and we were provided with binoculars, water and cookies. He has an exceptionally trained eye for finding birds. He spotted them without using any binoculars and was able to name the species and sex of every bird from a far distance. Kalametiya itself is beautifully peaceful in the morning, with a nice sun rise over the mangroves. At some point we briefly left the raft to climb on a rock, which gave an even better view. To our surprise he even played a bit of music on a flute and made a necklace out of flowers to accommodate this romantic trip. At the end of the trip he gave us a brief "exam" in which we could indicate all the birds we spotted during the trip. During the tour Bhuddi made several pictures and short videos of the trip. While we were making the exam, Bhuddi made a compilation of this footage into a short videoclip. When we were on shore again, he checked our exam and showed us a few birds in his book that we had forgotten to mention. He then showed us the beautiful video he made of the trip. All in all, the guide went out his way to make this activity an exceptional experience! He really put in the effort. On top of his enthusiasm and humor he has great knowledge and eye for the birds in the sanctuary.
title: Exceptional bird watching, with an exceptionally good guide!

body: We had a great time with buddhi and his colleague. We got water, cookies and binoculars on the boot. We saw 37 different bird species in the lagoon.Buddhi knows them all. This is really silent and peaceful place.We really enjoyed the trip, especially climbing on the rock with a great view for sunset. Thank you guys!
title: Awesome afternoon

body: Kalametiya shares many of its birds with other national parks like Bundala and Yala. But what distinguishes Kalametiya is the scenic landscape in which visitors can view the birds and of course Buddhi, our tour guide who amazes you with his talent for bird spotting and his knowledge of the lagoon.I arrived bit late, around 11 AM at the Sanctuary and wasn't hopeful of finding many birds. But Buddhi's talent and amazing energy made my visit a memorable one. We spotted about 40 bird species, and the plants of lagoon made me recall botany i had read in my pre-university days. Buddhi took us above the little rocky hill near the bank of the lagoon which provided an amazing view of the lagoon. The ease with which he climbed the hill with my little daughter in his arms was an amazing sight.He showed us little things about the lagoon such as the cactus fruit, the peacock eyed petal of water hyacinth in the lagoon. The wild wood apple in the trees. These are little things that you can't get in safaris in national parks. I highly recommend this safari. Kalametiya offers a unique birding experience in relaxed and unhurried environment which is quite rare.
title: Great landscape, great tour guide and lots of birds

body: My fiancé and I went on this tour at the recommendation of our resort manager. We are so glad we did. This was a highlight of our trip. Our guide, Buddhi, was awesome! He was very knowledgeable and gracious. We saw 38+ species of bird and beautiful landscape. I would go back just to float the reserve on the boat. Also, Buddhi, created a video of our experience which was an unexpected souvenir to share with our friends when we get home!
title: Peaceful Morning Tour

body: We recently did a birding excursion with Kalametiya Eco, and it was one of the highlights of our trip. The tour operator was super knowledgeable, friendly, and went out of his way to make the trip memorable, including developing a little video that we had not expected. A true pleasure! I highly recommend these folks, even if you're not into birds... you'll see some amazing things. Thanks!
title: Lovely!

body: We thoroughly enjoyed our bird watching tour with Bhuddi. We learnt a lot. Saw over40 species of birds. We loved his enthusiasm and knowledge. A very beautiful part of Srilanka. We also loved the breakfast at Upoint afterwards . The video he shot while on the trip was cool
title: Fantastic peaceful morning with very knowledgeable guide

body: The weather hadn’t been great the day we arrived at our hotel but we decided to take a chance early the next morning and embark on an Eco tour of the Kalametiya Lagoon with a lovely guy called Buddhi. He met us on time and drove us in a tuk-tuk to meet the boat where we were introduced to Ashan. We were spotting birds as soon as we left the hotel. Don’t be put off by weather to do this as we had a fantastic time. With the help of both guides we spotted 51 different varieties of beautiful birds. The lagoon is so relaxing. Gorgeous water lilies and water hyacinths cover the surface. Buddhi made a necklace from a water lily and handed us a bunch of water hyacinths. We were given a bottle of water each and a snack. We were out for over 3 hours and enjoyed every minute. Don’t hesitate to book these guys as they are polite, helpful, knowledgeable and funny. There is so much more to this trip but I don’t want to ruin the surprise...just book it and make memories!
title: Thank you Buddhi and Ashan

body: We had an amazing private lagoon tour. It was so calm and peaceful, very realxing! Even though we came a little bit late in the morning we saw a lot of different and beautiful birds. Our guide was very professional and could tell us everything about every little bird. We would definitly recommend it for every birdlover but also for everyoune else like us!Thanks for the amazing tour.
title: Peaceful and Beautiful

body: We visited the "bird sanctuary" with our Sri Lankan friends in April 2019. Bhuddi, the owner/operator of Kalametiya Eco Bird Watching is very knowledgeable and well organized. He had binoculars for everyone including the kids. He had even thought of bringing umbrellas (which came very handy). the perspective of a "quiz" for the kids at the end of the tour kept them engaged and attentive. As we were heading back to shore he served some fruit he had brought to share.A great experience! Highly recommended!
title: Perfect Guide

body: We had a really good time at Kalametiya Bird Sanctuary, our guide Buddhi is absolutely amazing, he is knowledgeable, respectful and fun. He spotted dozens of birds even without binoculars. The boat trip was comfortable and we were able to see more than 40 different bird species which was truly remarkable. After the bird watching we enjoyed climbing a rock view point from where you see all the surrounding area and enjoy sunset.We recommend the experience for every nature lover who comes to the south of Sri Lanka.
title: Discover the lovely nature of Sri Lanka with an amazing guide!

body: We’d read so many great reviews about Buddhi on Trip Advisor and were so glad that today’s technology allowed us to arrange the trip with Buddhi in advance from England. Further, having Buddhi as a WhatsApp contact before the trip truly saved us from a lot of stress when the driver which we had organised from our hotel to pick us up at 6am failed to turn up (driver was not associated with Buddhi or our hotel - he was someone who had sold his services to us on the beach and let us down). I was so distraught that our driver had not turned up and that we would not make it to our 6.20am appointment with Buddhi, having woken our 3 and 7 year old children up at 5.30am! Then I remembered I had Buddhi’s phone number and contacted him on WhatsApp. He greeted us with the biggest smile on my phone screen and calmed me down. Buddhi arranged a tuk tuk for us from Kalametiya to pick us up from our hotel and we were there shortly after 7am (normally it would have made sense to get transport from our end, but we had no idea at that early hour how to arrange it when our driver did a no-show on us). Despite the delay, which meant that by the end of our excursion with Buddhi the morning was much hotter than it would have been if we’d finished an hour earlier, as scheduled, and the water was moving a bit more (meaning that Buddhi and his helper had to row harder), Buddhi was all smiles the whole trip and is simply the nicest person who made us feel so special and welcome in his lake paradise. The bird watching itself was incredibly relaxing and interesting, both for ourselves, as adults, and our two children. 2 weeks on, our 3 year old is still saying “bird watching was sooo fun”. We all learnt to recognise many birds and also went on a little jungle walk and climbed a rock! I actually have a terrible fear of heights and stopped half way (it really was not that high!) but my 7 year old who is also scared of heights climbed it liked a mountain goat and Buddhi carried our 3 year old up and down. The view from the top was spectacular my husband tells me. I would recommend this trip to both experienced bird watchers who get the chance to witness the birds in such a peaceful place (we were the only ones there at the time) and to novices who want to experience the beauty of this lake with all its water flowers, birds and other animals. Thank you Buddhi for a lovely morning, which we are still reliving through photos on a daily basis!Ps none of the birds or animals appeared to be affected by our presence at all, and we just felt privileged to be a part of the peaceful morning lake scene.
title: Heavenly morning with Buddhi and the Birds

body: We had the most amazing time visiting the Kalametiya bird sanctuary. Myself and some friends enjoyed watching the birds and the amazing views here. We saw so many birds and myself being a lover of birds it was so much fun! Our tour guide was great and had a passion and love for birds and that it made it so much better. Thank you for such a lovely tour.
title: Kalametiya bird sanctuary

body: This was a spontaneous decision to go on this ride. Also maybe one of the nicest bird watching rides iv ever been on more so because of the lovely people who hosted us. Buddhi and ashan were so sweet and friendly. Looking into our comfort and super protective of us when climbing the rock. They even had biscuits and water bottles incase we got hungry and they snapped a bunch of photos of us for free. Much importantly they knew their birds and were literate about their job :) So safe to say that if your around the ranna area. This is they the best people to go to if your want to bird watch. Thank you so much for the experience guys! ✨
title: Best bird watching experience in Ranna

body: Fantastic excursion with great guide! Buddhi has a sharp eye and a very good knowledge of birds. He is also a great host, taking care of binoculairs, water and watermelon. Our 2 kids loved this trip as well, for Buddhi involved them in a really nice way, by making necklaces of waterlillies and letting him help peddling. He showed us the most beautiful sunset and surprised us with a movie that he made of our family during this trip. It was an unforgettable afternoon, and we highly recommend this excursion, Buddhi really knows how to make a difference!
title: Loved everything!

body: A very good expericence in a wild environment to observe beautiful birds on a boat. A very kind guide who knows a lot about birds. Intersting and magic moment with great people in a wonderful place. The guide took a lot of beautiful pictures and we had the surprise at the end of the trip to have a very nice video souvenir. Possibility to get down of the boat to climb at the top of a big rock to see the sunset and take pictures ! A visit to do ! :D
title: Kalametiya eco bird watching So great !!

body: We found Buddhi through reviews and he is definitely the best find for the entire trip.He helped us find some good camera rent out place, helped us to explore some other places in srilanka which has photographic significance.The first we took the ride with him it was raining but he still took us around in the rains well equipped.We were so happy with his service and his knowledge that even though we had a packed schedule we went for another safari on 3rd day afternoon which he happily accepted too.Such beautiful people make trips more memorable.Let all your goals be fulfilled Buddhi.We have even planned to book him for 10 days in our next trip 😀Great guy great guide.Buddhi+94713557925
title: If you wish to go to Kalametiya Buddhi is the only guide you should go with

body: We spent a fantastic afternoon on a boat. Our guide Buddhi equipped us with binoculars and together we observed over 30 types of birds. Buddhi helped us to identify the birds and made a list of species for us. Bird watching came to our hearts and for the next two weeks of our trip we were looking for more amazing birds of Sri Lanka. I highly recommend this trip.
title: Amazing experience

body: We reached there around 4 pm. There was a boatman and guide. Well organized. Boatman was experienced he paddled slowly which helped us to have a look and take photos. We were provided with safety jackets, snacks , binoculars and Bird guide book. Though this is not a well famous place it's really organized. We watched birds nearly 2 hrs. Few birds were there since this is off season. But first time experience. We had a good time. Both boatman and guide has eagle eyes. They can spot birds even from distance. For the whole trip they charged Rs. 5000/=
title: Rare experience

body: Take a boat trip at sunrise, and you will see a huge variety of Sri Lanka's resident wetland birds in a very short space of time. It is an amazing landscape, through which you travel slowly and silently, poled along by your boatman, who is also a very knowledgeable guide. While the winter months will have a the migrants adding to the variety, there is no doubt that in the space of a three hour boat trip you will see an awful lot of birds, plus water monitors, crocodiles, monkeys, mongoose, and waterbuffalo. Highly recommended.
title: Best at dawn

body: Our driver picked us up at 5.30 to get us to Kalametiya Eco Bird Sanctuary just before 6am where we were met by our guide and boatman. Our guide was very knowledgeable, interesting and fun. He made my daughter a necklace from a water lily and played an enchanting tune on a handmade bamboo flute. Half way through the trip we got off the boat and climbed up to the top of a large rock where we were able to see an amazing panoramic view. We were able to spot about 32 of the 140 birds which are seen at this sanctuary as well as water buffalo and Sri Lankan monkeys. This trip is a must for anyone visiting Sri Lanka.
title: Wow! An amazingly beautiful start to the day!

body: We chose this place because of the great reviews and we were really satisfied. Our guide was very professional and passionate, he speaks very good English. We had our own little boat, we saw loads of birds and two large monitor lizards as well. We also got our very own list that contained the bird species we saw that morning. We even got some coconut drink and fruit during the tour.Bring hat and sun block as there are no shades during the tour.I really recommend this place to visit.
title: Great birding experience

body: We had a lovely morning with Budi on the water. It is well organised and seamless. We went on the 6am tour as the birds are said to be more active (we saw over 40 types of birds in 2hrs). Our guide was Budi and he was both friendly and knowledgeable. He was able to spot all birds with his naked eye and provided both me and my partner with high quality binoculars to get a closer look. We also saw monkeys in the trees, lizards and a water buffalo. You are given the opportunity to wade through shallow water (ankle deep) to the land and climb up on top of a massive rock. The panoramic views from the top are beautiful. Budi served us fresh watermelon and water about half way through the morning. At the conclusion of the trip you are provided with a list of all the birds you have seen on your tour. It is a unique and interesting tour that we would highly recommend.
title: Something different

body: Budi took us out at dawn on a fantastic several hours of bird watching and boating. He and the team were very well informed and provided us with a most enjoyable tour.
title: Brilliant

body: Fabulous tour. Got to see lots of birds on a very relaxing Catamaran. We were given some delicious watermelon and the opportunity to try out a flute before watching the beautiful sunset on Taragalla rock. The tour ended with some fantastic photos and videos to keep for our memories!
title: Bird lagoon

body: A must do trip if you’re keen to see Sri Lankan birdlife! This trip we saw 43 species of bird as well as water monitor and mongoose. Our guide Buddhi has an extensive knowledge of the wildlife and gave a thorough commentary as we were punted along the waterways. The trip was good value too, with use of binoculars included. Highly recommended.
title: 6am Kalametiya safari

body: We really enjoyed our bird watching tour by Kalametiya Eco Bird Watching. We opted for the 6am tour and were rewarded by over 52 species within our 2.5 hour tour. We definitely saw the most between 6am-7am so well worth getting up for. Buddhi was an excellent guide - very keen to point out the wide diversity of species out to us and very knowledgable. We’re fairky keen bird spotters in the UK and had come to Sri Lanka with a bird book in hand - but gained so much more from the experience of our lovely guides. Highly recommend.
title: Fabulous experience

body: Such a fabulous tour through the bird sanctuary, guided by the multi-talented Buddhi. From the outset, Buddhi was spotting birds and giving us information. It was so tranquil. Definitely worth getting up very early! I even climbed the Rock with the assistance of the guides. There were so many ways Buddhi made the tour an exceptional experience .... I don't want to spoil it for you ... just book a trip for yourself ... you won't be disappointed.
title: Wonderful bird watching tour

body: We have just returned from a wonderful tour, run by Buddhi. It was serene, being slowly guided through the waters. Buddhi has a tremendous knowledge of the whole habitat and was able to spot birds very quickly. We saw 45 different birds. I particularly loved the kingfishers and the beautiful yellow oriole. I never thought I would manage to climb the rock - but I did with the help of our guides. Thanks to everyone involved.
title: Early morning tour at Kalamatiya Bird Sanctuary

body: The Kalametiya Bird Sanctuary was nature at its finest. Mangroves, grasses and pristine water everywhere. So beautiful. Oh yeah and BIRDS, BIRDS, BIRDS! We saw 44 species of birds as helpfully and masterfully identified and explained by Buddhi, the most polite, knowledgeable and friendly guide you could ever imagine. Water and fruit were provided and the double hull platform boat had comfortable upright seating that allowed for panoramic views using professional quality binoculars provided for us. I couldn’t imagine choosing a different company for any reason. 100% guaranteed unforgettable experience!
title: Phenomenal Bird Watching and the Most Amazing Guide!

body: Fantastic trip with great bird life (we saw 55 species including Bitterns). Buddhi arranged the tour at short notice and is a very knowledgable and effective guide. It was a real pleasure to spend 3 hours with him. We moved slowly through the water and had the chance to see a great variety of birds. There was water and fruit provided, and even some flute playing! Great value for money and highly recommended.
title: Bird watching trip on boat with Buddhi as guide

body: On our 6 day trip to down south, we decided to devote half a day to do a bird watching tour in Kalametiya Bird Sanctuary. From a recommendation of a friend, we selected Buddhi as our host. The choice we made was excellent because the tour was a highlight in our entire trip. Here are the reasons why you should do this tour and why you should do it with Buddhi.1. Buddhi knows his stuff well. The birds, the best timing to watch birds, habitats and everything you can think of.2. Even if you go empty handed, knowing nothing, he will give you leaflets to refer, binoculars and even refreshments!3. He will take his time and try to show you everything possible. So, the money you pay is worth paying.4. He will give you the best experience and he will make sure you will enjoy it to the extreme. He took us to the rocky hillock on the side of the lagoon. When you climb to the top, you can see a 360 view of everything around you and mind you, it’s amazing!5. He will give every chance to take pictures, even if you are not a photographer.6. He can play the flute well. He will play you a tune when you are about to end the tour. Imagine hearing flute music early in the morning while you are floating in a boat, surrounded by nature! That’s wonderful.7. At the end of the tour, he will get together with you and mark all the birds you saw in a sheet and that’s like a record book.8. Buddhi is one of the most humble and amazing personality and he will make sure to give you the best of it. If we go there again, we will definitely go to him again. Even if you go the same tour again, I am pretty sure it will be interested every time
title: We Are Glad We Took This Tour!!

body: Thanks to bhuddi for a wonderful morning trip! Buddhi had so much knowledge about birds! And makes a very Nice video with all the pictures he takes of you! Highly recommended!
title: Wonderful birdwatching

body: I had read about visiting the Kalametiya Bird Sanctuary and am so thrilled we decided to go. Its certainly a hidden gem for those who love to see birds! We saw over 44 kinds of birds and were able to get some wonderful photos. Buddhi was absolutely the best guide. I started calling him superman as he really has incredible hearing and sight and could see the rare species and direct us to it. He is a wonderful guide with a wealth of knowledge and passion for the area! He is also a great flute player we got to know and made a really great real time video of our experience!! Would highly recommend visiting and exploring with Buddhi!
title: Hidden Gem

body: We spent a good time with Buddhi and his friend,He seems very passionate about birds and full of surprise!We spend a pleasant and peaceful time with him watching the beauty of nature ,
title: Pleasant afternoon with Buddhi!

body: We met Gayan and staff at sunrise time for this amazing experience. Competence, good English to explain and a rapid eye, we enjoyed silent boat rowing in nature, and a gorgeous landscape where Marabous, kingfishers, airons, peacocks, blue chickens and a lot of species live beside big buffalos taking bath. The Nice climbing of a rock was the cherry on the pie, with an unforgettable view.... Very recommended ecotour!
title: A wonderful sunrise at birds' Paradise

body: We were in Tangalle and saw on Google Maps the Eco Bird Watching Tour. Cause of the positive recommendation we wrote him in the night if we could go for the next day early morning 6 o'clock tour. He answered and we came with our car in the next morning. We were cordially received with a Tea and after we drove to the bird park. He took us on a boat to explore the birds world. He knows and explained us a lot about birds. He has eagle eyes... He saw better then we with the Googles 😅. For all photographers... Get an higher objective then 200mm and probably a tripod. U have the time and the space if u are two on a trip 😁.He served while the trip watermelon and water and was pretty polite. Buddhi was by far the best guide we saw on our 3 weeks vacation on Sri Lanka. He speaks fluently English and give us the best trip thru the birds world of Sri Lanka!Thank you Buddhi!
title: Musst-Have! Birdwatching with Buddhi, the bird expert

body: My wife and I went on a fantastic two and a half hour trip with Buddhi and his friend Hashan (who rowed the boat). This was our first time birding, and Buddhi's enthusiasm and knowledge really brought the landscape to life as we observed and learned about all the different species of bird in this picturesque wetland reserve. We saw 53 different species of bird in one morning (everything from herons to kingfishers - and even a monitor lizard) amazing! They supply everything you need - binoculars, water, snacks - and can arrange transport from your hotel. Buddhi even played a little tune on the flute on our way back which was a nice touch. This was a glorious trip and a real highlight of our holiday in Sri Lanka.
title: A fantastic trip brought alive by Buddhi's enthusiasm

body: My and husband I did the bird watching tour this morning. It's an early start (6am) but soo worth it. We have never been bird watching before but it was an amazing experience. The lagoon is completly quiet and peaceful at that time and you set out when the sun is just about to rise. Buddhi, the founder and our guide, was fantastic. He has such a vast knowledge about the local birds & area and gives you a lot of background knowledge about their habitat and behaviours. He puts a lot of effort and love into the tour to make it a memorable experience (and it truly was). We didn't just sit on the boat but also walked through the grass land and climbed a rock (from which you have an amazing view). He took pictures along the trip which he edited into a little video on the go and shared with us after the trip. It definitely was one of my highlights during our Sri Lanka holiday and I would highly recommed it to anyone (we did it as a couple but it would also be a great tour to do with kids).
title: Amazing experience

body: We had a fantastic time exploring the reserve with Buddhi. He was friendly, knowledgeable and made the whole experience a delight. We saw 50 species of birds and he really helped bring the reserve to life, even providing an epic personalised video of our tour! Would definitely recommend.
title: Tour of Kalametiya bird sanctuary with Buddhi

body: The combination of excellent birding and stunning scenery made this tour with our guide, Buddhi, an experience i will never forget! Buddhi is very enthusiastic, a smile on his face at all times. He also has an incredibly sharp eye and can spot birds excellently and identify them instantly. We saw 62+ species from 6am onwards, watching the beautiful sunrise surrounded by hundreds of birds. I highly recommend Buddhi and his business and this tour is a must for any nature enthusiast in Sri Lanka. Many thanks to Buddhi for this unforgettable birding trip!
title: Incredible Experience!

body: Our gentle 3-hour paddle with Buddhi through the wetland was the most unforgettable experience. We left at 6am and it took just over 3 hours. We are keen birders, but not experts. Even if you are not very interested in birds this is still an incredible thing to do, paddling out as the sun came up and seeing and hearing the wetland come alive. From a birding point of view it was fantastic and we saw well over 60 species in 3 hours, including bitterns, minivets, every kind of kingfisher, fish eagles and several other raptors. Buddhi is a wonderful person, a very warm and enthusiastic guy, very knowledgable about the local birds and birds in general, and an excellent host for this trip. You will not find a better guide anywhere! Added to that he is a very good photographer and documented our trip as we went along, and before we had even landed he presented us with a video of the trip, complete with really great photography. What a way to start the day! I wish Buddhi and his business every success in the future!
title: Stunning experience with an awesome guide!

body: We absolutely loved the tour of Kalametiya Bird Sanctuary with Buddhi. He was able to organise a 6am tour for us at very short notice (night before), it was well organised and a lovely experience for birders and non-birders alike. Buddhi is very knowledgeable about the local birds and a pleasure to spend a few hours with. Highly recommended.
title: Excellent tour!

body: This tour has been an absolute highlight of our trip. We took a peaceful ride through the sanctuary, whilst Buddhi took his time to explain and show us as many of the birds as possible, whilst also explaining the area. We went in the afternoon and I can certainly recommend doing the same if only for the beautiful sunset on the rock at the end. It was a very special moment. As we slowly returned Buddhi played for us on the flute, together with the scenery it was a magical ending. Thoroughly worth the visit, do not hesitate to book with these guys. Thank you!!
title: Unforgettable, unmissable.

body: We travelled in a punt on a large lagoon and saw many interesting birds.The location is beautiful and tranquil. A pleasant way to spend time even if you're not very interested in birds. Our guide Buddhi was excellent: knowledgeable, personable and conscientious. His email is info@kalametiyabirds.lk
title: Excellent birdwatching trip

body: Go there. That's incredible, and every nature lover will be amazed :)Many different birds, guides that help you understand what birds are there, where they are (they really have a good eye !)GO THERE :)
title: WONDERFUL

body: Buddhi was very nice and accommodating throughout. He has an impressive knowledge and a sharp eye for birds while the rest of us took awhile to spot them even with binoculars provided. He had little surprises along the way which made it a truly memorable experience. He also took us to some dry land and climbed up a rock overlooking the beautiful sanctuary (you'll be stepping barefoot in some shallow waters). It can get quite sunny but umbrellas are provided. All in all very pleasant and relaxing. I'll be happy to go back there again. Keep it up, Buddhi :)
title: Pleasantly surprised

body: We came on this boat Safari tour with our local guide who recommended it as the best! It really was: we started early at 6am and met Buddhi who gave us a wonderful experience. We saw over 60 different birds both from his boat and from a high rock overlooking the whole wetland. He was kind and helpful - we are seniors - very knowledgeable, well equipped and also provided light refreshments. Binoculars were available as well as bird books. We were shown photos of the birds that we had seen to reinforce our memorys.As we returned after 2½ hours, he played haunting tunes on his Sri Lankan flute. Altogether we had a wonderful experience. I would highly recommend these tours in the peace and beauty of the Kalametiya Bird Sanctuary.
title: The best!

body: This morning (6.30) we had a wonderful punting-tour with Buddhi. He sees all the birds even from far away and guides you with the binoculars so you can find them easily. Buddhi is also great in explaining, so we (no birdwatchers usually) learned a lot. The whole boat trip was quiet and peaceful, respecting the nature. We climbed a little rock for a wonderful overview of the sanctuary. Buddhi provided some fresh watermelon and water on the trip as well. While on tour Buddhi shot beautiful pictures of us that he immediately sent to us afterwards. And there were many other things, nice little surprises. If I could give 6 stars (out of 5) I would give them. We did a Uda Walawe Safari, but this was way better.
title: Outstanding Tour - a must see

body: My wife and myself went today on this tour and I must say it was one of the highlights of our trip.We saw 50 different species of bird and our guide Buddhi was amazing.He’s only a young man but he has amazing knowledge and more importantly he has a big heart and is a very likable man.There are “tours” and there are “tours” and this was certainly the latter.This trip should be one of the first on your list.Highly recommended
title: Wow wow wow

body: The Bird Watching Tour was one of our highlights during our 3 weeks stay in Sri Lanka. The tour took about 2,5 hours and started at 6:15am in the morning. We went there by scooter from Tangalle by our own with no problem (30min ride). The boat ride on the lagoon during sunrise was amazing. We also climbed up a rock and had a great view. Our tour guide Buddhi is a very polite and positive person. He has such a great knowledge about birds. Very brilliant. We really enjoyed the tour and can highly recommend it.
title: Awesome Experience

body: First of all thank you to our guide Budi (hope I spell it right!)!!He was so into showing us the birdlife in the lagoon... amazing!We saw 47 differnet species of birds, bathing buffalos and one amazing sunset!! Thank you my friend! We enjoyed every second! I recommend the afternoon tour, although I didn’t do the morning one... sorry folks!It was just way above what we expected! Take care.
title: Wonderful bird watching experience!

body: Amazing place, very interesting tour, led by a very competent and friendly guide. We enjoyed it a lot.
title: Birdwatching

body: Beautiful & peaceful place to visit. We saw close to 60 different bird species thanks to Buddhi, who is very professional and great with kids.
title: Great experience

body: a fantastic place to visit, so quiet and relaxing well worth a afternoon out.being punted around the lagoon was great
title: we saw 45 different kinds of birds

body: Found Kalametiya on the internet before our stay at Tangalle last year and our driver took us very early morning. We enjoyed it so much we did it all again this year and were not disappointed so many birds and the tranquility is perfect with just the sound of the punting pole pushing the catamaran among the inland waterway as the sun comes up.
title: 2nd Visit.

body: We arrived via cruise ship so were later than optimal for viewing the maximum number of birds (usually Buddhi starts at 6 AM and we started around 9:30 AM). Despite that, Buddhi did a fantastic job for us--due to his keen eyes (and those of his friend, who was poling the pontoon boat through the mangroves), we were able to spot and quickly identify reclusive birds: 50 different species!It was so quiet and peaceful as we glided through the water, with many stops for sightings. Too many highlights to mention, but a couple include seeing Sri Lanka's largest kingfisher as well as every variety of egret - all at once!!!! - riding on the backs of swimming water buffaloes!Buddhi provided excellent high power binoculars, bird books, water and fresh watermelon as a snack midway through the tour. He is quite musical, too - played a traditional flute-like instrument for us on the way back. After our tour, we were invited to his home for refreshments: homemade fresh fruit smoothies (made from fruit from their own trees), thin coconut filled dosas and crisp fried (not sweet) 'cookies' or biscuits. Yum!Later, Buddhi sent us a wonderful memory of our trip that he filmed during our time with him. Tip: Buddhi arranged our transport from the ship to Kalametiya for us. We chose an A/C car (which took about 1/2 hour). This is definitely the right choice. We could have had a tuk-tuk but it would have taken a lot longer and not as comfortable.To sum it up: We could not have been happier. Great alternative to Hambantota choices closer to the ship.
title: Buddhi is the best!

body: Beautiful and quiet flowting in a fantasticbird sanctuary. The small wooden boat has no motor and is being staged around the low water area. We saw 54 different types of birds in 2 1/2 hours. The guide was very knowlegdable.Very enjoyable and can be recommended if you love birdwatching, but also if you just enjoy a slow floating experience in a beautiful piece of nature.I recommend to buy the book "Birds of Sri Lanka" (Helm field guide) at home to bring on your holiday.
title: Birds everywhere

body: This was my second visit to Kalametiya, and the place was just as I remembered - teeming with birdlife and other creatures, peaceful and serene. Buddhi knows the birds and the environenment can tell a lot about them. We had an unfortunate 'work accident' at the peak of the tour when Buddhi dropped his phone to the water. And to his bad luck this happened at the deeper and muddier part of the lagoon, meaning that we werent able to retrieve it. Buddhi, I hope you are able to find the phone, and at least save the contents of thr sim-card!
title: Lovely place and great service concept

body: 3-hour private dawn trip on wetland with Singha a knowledgeable local guide in small double-hulled boat punt-powered! Many species of birds and water buffalo and monkeys. Ideal for bird enthusiasts but so tranquil and such wonderful vistas, would be a treat for all.We were provided with snacks and water. Binoculars available, but advise take your own.
title: Wonderful peaceful wetland trip at sunrise

body: What an amazing experience. The bird sanctuary is very beautiful and we saw so many bird species, including kingfishers, birds of prey, small endemic species, migratory birds and the Sri Lankan jungle fowl. Buddha our guide was very knowledgeable and friendly. Highly recommend!
title: Stunning!

body: It was a real pleasure to do another boat trip with Buddhi - a fine young man so passionate about his job,so knowledgeable about the birds and engaging considerate and always smiling but importantly a consummate professional.He is in top tier of things to do in Sri Lanka on trip advisor and will do in his power to maintain is 100% five star reviews and will not favour financial gain to compromise this.For example during our trip it was quite windy and although we saw 34 birds well down from last year it was still very enjoyable in the paddled boat.He advised a group he would not take them in the afternoon as it was too windy and they would be disappointed - he could have gone ahead for financial gain but did not - that is his integrity and honesty that i admireHe has such a bright futiure - a mega watt personality carry out a highly professional eco conscious tour Well done Buddhi
title: Buddhi Superstar

body: It was a great learning experience with Buddhi. We saw a lot of unique birds, and Buddhi had tons of information
title: Amazing experience

body: Fabulous, beautiful, unexpected, relaxing, well explained and very friendly visit. Recommended to all!!
title: Amazing learning experience

body: Magic, relaxing and special experience - don’t hesitate one second!! Perfect stop on the way to Weligama or to yala depending on your way
title: Go there!!

body: We did the morning boat tour with Buddhi at Kalametiya. We were very impressed with his knowledge of the birds of Sri Lanka. I loved that the boats were non-motorized...it was so peaceful. We noticed another boat only had one guy doing it all. Buddhi has a guy poling the boat through the water for him so that he is not distracted and is able to spot many birds for us. His English is very good and he is very enthusiastic about what he is doing. And that smile! This is a wonderful way to spend the early morning. I highly recommend it.
title: Beautiful place for Bird Watching

body: A relatively small area, with lits of interesting birds, hence a very good density. Excelent photo oportunities of spectacular birds (Darter, Jacana, Purple Swamphen, Grey-headed Fish Eagle etc...). Buddhi was my guide, he is very knowledgeable of the local birds and happy to oblige for a good spotting or a great photo. Plus a very nice company in general. Overall a great experience and a very good value for the money.
title: Intense birding experience

body: This is well worth place to visit and carry beautiful memories of scenary . If you are visiting downsouth or Kataragama , this is a very good place for few hours.
title: Beautiful place to visit

body: It was a nice chillout time with guides who are able to spot beautiful birds. Professional, nice, helpful team of guides, with a lot of humor. Binoculars, fruits, water included. Hiking to the top of a rock not challenging, to be done by small kids. Beautiful view from the top. Very recommended!
title: Beautiful scenery and time

body: Buddhi is such an enthusiastic, friendly, proessional and knowledgeable young man that you cannot help to enjoy this bird watching boat trip, even if you never before gave wildlife a second thought! We saw over 50 different species, not fleetingly, but sitting still on trees or water, long enough for really good examination. Buddhi taught us a lot in the time we were with him! Early morning was such a peaceful, quiet time on the water. Overall, this was probably our best experience in Sri Lanka.
title: Our best memory from Sri Lanka

body: This was an amazing experience and we saw lots of birds. The guide knows a lot about them and we learned a lot. We also got watermelons and water. Will definitly recommend this activity.
title: Peaceful Bird Watching on a boat - with well informed guides

body: Buddhi and his team were so good! he knows all about the birds an the area and is in love with the nature around sri lanka- thank you so much for everthig!
title: Bird-Safari

body: These to guys know everything about this beautiful area and specially about the birds! They appreciate nature with much love wich is wonderful to see. The boat is powered by one guy and a woodstick, so it is very quiet and naturefriendly.The tour was absolutely amazing they couldn’t do it better! We had so much fun today and we learned a lot about birds. I would love to tell every detail about the tour but then is the magic for the surprises gone. So better just book a tour and let the magic happen.Thank you so much guys for today it was sooo good!
title: Amazing!

body: A really great tour and fantastic value for money. Kalametiya is beautiful and very tranquil, and we saw a huge range of different bird species. Buddhi is an excellent guide - very knowledgeable about the birds, extremely enthusiastic and adds lots of nice touches.
title: Fantastic Experience

body: This trip was booked as part of my ‘special’ 😉 birthday treat. Whilst being gently punted around a vast wetlands by 2 lovely boatmen we saw an abundance of birds, water buffalo & the piece de resistance- a Water Monitor Lizard!! Buddhi’s knowledge, enthusiasm and passion for this place is incredible. Buddhi’s extra touches like a bouquet of water hyacinths & garland of water lilies were very special. We also enjoyed some very welcome fruit and water provided by our team. With Buddhi’s ‘eagle eye’ & the provision of binoculars we saw species of birds we would never could have imagined! Who knew there were so many types of Kingdisher! After punting through the mangroves & passing lounging water buffalo we then embarked onto land to scale a rock. We paddled barefoot through the beautiful Water Hyaciths and then with Buddhi’s expert guidance & skill (and nerves of steel!) we climbed the immense rock barefoot!!! The panoramic views from here were breathtaking. THANK YOU for adding some incredible memories to my birthday 🙏🏼This tour is an absolute MUST DO if you’re visiting Sri Lanka. It’s suitable for ALL ages and will open your mind to a world of tranquil, beauty and nature at its absolute best. Book with Buddhi - you won’t be disappointed 💚
title: Beautiful, Idyllic & great Fun!

body: Highly recommended,a beautiful setting and a very competent guide in the shape of Buddhi who's spotting and recognition skills were exceptional. In all we personally identified and recorded 57 different species in a couple of hours whilst being leisurely rowed around the lagoon. A must visit for anyone interested in bird life.
title: Gabriel Peachey

body: We had a wonderful experience on the early morning bird watching tour. We're not bird watchers but loved the beautiful & peaceful sanctuary and feel getting up at 5am was worth it! We saw 51 different species of birds, thanks to Buddhi and his eagle eyes! 🦅 Buddhi is extremely knowledgeable, has an incredible ability to spot birds and was very engaging. He was so fun and excited to share his knowledge with us. We highly recommend going with Buddhi.
title: Great Bird Watching

body: 6.30 sunrise punt silently past bathing buffalo, glide through water hyacinths and if you are lucky observe a giant lizard asleep in a tree.Leave the boat to wade through open meadows and clamber a rock for 360 degree viewpoint of mangroves, lagoons and sea.This trip is NOT just about BIRDS if you enjoy boating trips appreciate a variety of landscapes and want to view nature in its morning glory then this is the trip for you.If you are a bird enthusiast you will be in your element! The guide is english speaking knowledgeable and enthusiastic.We saw so many different species of Sri Lankan birds, so colourful compared with our own birds. I took so many stunning photographs, a truly memorable trip. DO IT! Worth every penny our guide was so passionate about his job and this enthusiasm ensured the trip was full of awe and wonder for his guests. Thank you so much Buddhi Priyankara the trip was greatly appreciated! The trip lasted about 2 and a half hours.Awesome trip and highly recommended!!
title: Tranquil magical punting adventure through lagoons and mangroves!TRULY ENCHANTING!!

body: We had a really wonderful time with Buddhi on his boat. He does his job with so much passion and we could feel that at every moment during our cruise in the stunning lagoon. Even though it was raining we were lucky to see around 45 different birds, all spotted through the binoculars that Buddhi had offered us. It was great to get all the interesting information about everything we wanted to know and Buddhi really made an effort to make it a truly amazing experience for us. We would highly recommend it to everyone who is keen on seeing many beautiful birds in a peaceful landscape and just relax a bit outside of the busy beach. It is definitely worth to do!
title: A must do in the south of Sri Lanka!

body: This bird sanctury is well worth a trip, lots of birdlife and serene being paddled on lagoon by informative guide
title: Fabulous

body: Buddhi’s enthusiasm and knowledge of local bird life make this an experience not to be missed. The variety of birds is something special and Buddhi incorporates lots of little surprises to ensure you have an unforgettable outing. It is so peaceful out on the water, the trip is excellent value and even for non bird enthusiasts this is a wonderful way to spend a few hours.
title: Highlight in Sri Lanka

body: The owner young Buddhika and his friend Ushan are excellent on the subject. We were able to see and photograph a variety of birds with their help. Being on the paddle boat made all the difference as there was no noise of a motor which I thought was very environmental friendly. Buddhika's reed music while on the boat was enchanting and made the evening even more beautiful. That was not all! They got us to climb a rock! It was hilarious as we struggled up and down on our fours! This activity (bird watching) is a must if you are spending an evening in Hambantota.
title: For Any Bird Lover

body: We took a sunrise lagoon tour with Buddhi. Such a peaceful, relaxing experience and unlike other Sr Lankan wildlife tours this really was just us and the birds. Buddhi's amazing spotting skills ensure you will see upwards of 50 different bird varieties, his knowledge and enthusiasm make this a very enjoyable experience. Amazingly beautiful place, go now before it gets discovered!(Just one complaint, Buddhi is a terrible judge of age, don't let him guess yours!)
title: Great experience

body: We did the tour with Buddi on 16th Jan and it was one of the highlights of our two week trip. We were staying in Tangalle at the time and had been tipped off by our driver about Kalametiya being much better than Bundala National Park for seeing birds as you can get much closer to the birds. Buddi was also recommended to us as well, and his tour does not disappoint!We saw 53 species of birds in total, and as Buddi has an encyclopedic knowledge and great eye for the birds of Sri Lanka, you'll be sure to get to see plenty! It just depends what nature has in store for you that day! Buddi has binoculars if you don't have your own and he also carries field guides with pictures for reference. You'll get to climb a small rock for scenic views, and you'll actually see some different birds whilst you're on foot. We saw a very low perched shikra on this part! The freshly sliced watermelon and bottled water was also a very nice touch, expecially as the morning temperature starts to rise. We also did a quiz back at Buddi's with a glass of fresh wood apple juice, which is well worth trying if you get the chance! Overall, a very calm, relaxing morning tour in beautiful scenery, with plenty of birds to see as well as Buffalo and sea/land monitors. If you're really lucky, you'll also get a flute solo from Buddi, a man of many talents!
title: Bird lover's paradise!

body: Kalametiya bird watching with Buddhi and Ashan was a highlight of our tour down south. It is a bird watcher’s paradise. A very well organised boat trip by these very knowledgeable young men is a must for anybody interested in bird watching.Thank you Buddhi and Ashan.
title: Kalametiya bird watching

body: We saw 48 different kinds of birds and loved every minute of it! The lagoon is beautiful and peaceful, and Buddhi is a truly excellent guide!
title: Excellent bird-watching experience!

body: This bird sighting was incredible. I've never seen so many bird species in one place. Buddi was an amazing guide. He has a book with all kinds of birds and has always explained which one we have seen. The lagoon is so peaceful and beautiful, and the view from the rock we climbed was incredible. What a beautiful place! We also got water and watermelon. We had an afternoon tour and then we had to catch a bus to Tissamaharama and Budhhi was so nice that he took us to the bus station with his grease fat and stopped the bus for us. Great experience. We can recommend this place to everyone!
title: One of the best experiences in Sri Lanka!

body: It is not only about the birds... Lagoon safari was great. At first I can't believe so many species of birds on one area, we saw more then 44 species. Buddhi had many nice surprises for us, for example huge rock we climb on top, but the other one is secret - you have to try it on your own... Believe me, you will spend great time - Buddhi is very funny boy.
title: Best guid ever!!!

body: This place is a must see for all nature and birds lovers, you can really watch many many different kinds and unbelievably beautiful birds in natural environment. Slow and silent move of the boat does not distract you or any birds so you become a part of the mother nature life in this area. Buddhi was delicate and passionate about birds, he answered all the questions we had, and even more. He's dedication and passion are really inspiring. I thank him for this excursion and safe and interesting path to the rocks. Wood Apple drink was also great before and after the trip. In total we saw 44 of 141 birds and a Buffalo.Cheers, - Vova
title: Wonderful

body: What a fantastic trip. Very professional, friendly and interesting. They really went above and beyond to provide us with a memorable experience. Thanks Budhhi,Patrick & Nicole
title: Awesome

body: We are very happy that we found this trip. We saw lots of birds, guide is knowledgeable and very friendly. We also saw some monkeys and tasted first time cactus fruit. We traveled from Tangalle, so it was not too far even in the early morning, he also arranged our pick up. We hope that the area stays as natural as it is now and that local people protect it, so we can visit again when back in Sri Lanka. We recommend this highly if you are in the area.
title: Great rainy morning with the birds in Kalametiya

body: The guide is a lovely person and highly knowledgeable of all the birds. Wonderful and relaxing experience and one of the highlights of our trips to Sri Lanka, would highly recommend it.
title: Excellent tour!

body: Kalametiya Bird Sanctuary is a beautiful place. Buddhi, our very experienced guide made our visit very special. I was alone with my son on the boat and we enjoyed every moment of it. Plenty of time to take pictures, listening to Buddhi's explanations. We also climbed a rock to enjoy the sunset. Fresh fruits and water were offered. Thank you Buddhi for the lovely video you sent me. A very special memory...
title: Wonderful experience, peaceful and informative

body: So nice, the best thing we’ve done so far in Sri Lanka. Extremely friendly guide who knows a lot about birds and his hospitality is incredible. Hope to do this one day again! Thanks Buddhi!
title: Wonderful

body: Absolutely amazing bird safari. I went on the morning tour, which starts at 6am. A truely magical place and beautiful haven (conservation area) in which you can view the many and varied types of beautiful srilanken birds both from the water and land. Extremely knowledgeable guide and very passionate about what he does. Would highly recommend, really fantastic bird safari ❤
title: Absolutely amazing bird safari

body: Our best day in Sri Lanka? Eco bird watching with Buddhi and his friend Asham. It was amazing!!! I never see something better and enjoyable. Buddhi is a really nice person, I felt so good with him. Thank you Buddhi and thank you Asham. When we come back to Sri Lanka, we will definitely come back to meet you.🙏
title: Do this this tour if you want something special!!

body: Had a great time with our 2 teenage children. Buddhi goes the extra mile to make sure everyone enjoys the trip. First time bird watching, saw close to 40 species. It ends with a little nature walk and a climb up a tick. The views were amazing at sunset. Such a tranquil afternoon spent at Kalametiya. Highly recommend !
title: Amazing!

body: I'm not a birder by any means and had a great time on this tour. We saw 57 different species of bird of all sizes and brilliant colors. Buddhi is a fantastic guide - he is passionate and enthusiastic about his job, knows all of the different species on the lagoon, and his English is great. He also has super-human eye sight and could spot and identify birds that I could barely even see without my binoculars! If you are in the area, you really, really should do this tour. I highly suggest going very early in the morning when you're likely to see a lot of different types of birds and there are very few people out on the lagoon. Do it, do it, do it!
title: DO THIS TOUR!

body: My wife, her sister and I went bird watching with Buddhi, our guide, in a catamaran boat powered by his assistant who used a long pole to propel us. The setting was tranquil, with the small sound of water napping our boat. We saw maybe five or six different birds in the first few minutes and we're told the names of all of them. Unfortunately we forgot them shortly thereafter, but luckily we saw them again and again so we got to practiced their names. In the end we saw more than 40 species. I highly recommend the tour for both the birds you will see and the knowledgeable guide.
title: Bird watching

body: Marvellous experience in a pristine environmentWe had a wonderful morning with Buddhi and his oarsman.Buddhi helped us spot over 50 types of birds.My 11 year old daughter absolutely loved the experience and couldn't stop talking about it afterwardsWhether you are an experienced bird watcher or a family like ourselves who just wanted to experience something new,Buddhi is the perfect guide.His love and knowledge of birds and the environment just shines through and I would highly recommend anyone who is staying around Tangalle to try itMany thanks Buddhi. Kevin Dewi and Kyla
title: Wonderful Morning

body: We visited the bird sanctuary after reading all 5 star reviews on TA and Buddhi didn't disappoint us. The place is very quiet with hardly any tourists around. Buddhi is a very knowledgeable person and takes efforts to show as many bird species as possible. We saw more than 56 types of birds. Undoubtedly our best experience in Sri Lanka!!!
title: Superb!!

body: One of the best ride. Buddhi's Knowledge about birds is remarkable. Even my 5 year old enjoyed the whole trip. His boat is equipped with all the necessary items that fit for perfect bird watch(including snacks ).
title: Amazing Experience

body: Buddhi and his boat captain offered a wonderful early morning tour to this pretty unique lagoon.Bird watching was excellent, with Buddhi spotting even the tiniest birds in the far distance. Eagle eyes indeed..Has an excellent knowledge of the more than 50 species of birds in this area.
title: Great experience with enthusiatic guides

body: If you were on the south of Sri Lanka, visit this place with the Buddhi. He is so friendly a nice guy, just his smile made us happy in the morning. We met with him at 6:00 A. M. and than we went to watch the lagoon with the birds. He showed us on the boat more than 50 types of birds. He explained us everything about the birds and about their lifes. It was so interesting experience for us. He and his friend (boat driver) prepared for us the fresh fruits and we tried something special. 😉 If I can I would like to give him seven stars, but on the Trip advisor is the maximum just five stars! For me und my boyfriend it was the most amazing trip on the Sri Lanka!! Buddhi, we would like to say big thank you again and again!! Definitely visit this place with Buddhi!! I recommend you this place. Never forget this guy!! With love Tereza & Adnrew
title: Eco Bird Watching

body: It’s a very attractive area which has many species of birds specially migrated rare species.also you can enjoy catemoren riding.This guide has a big knowledge about bird watching.
title: Bird watching

body: We went on the bird watching tour yesterday at the sanctuary and it was a great experience! We got to ride on a little catamaran boat through this beautiful wetland area and we saw 58 different species of birds! The guide was very enthusiastic and knowledgeable about the birds! We did a little hike up a rock for a great lookout of the whole area. We also got some cookies and water during the trip and some fresh mango and wood Apple at the end of the tour. We also were given a list of all the birds we had seen during the tour. The guide also took some really nice pictures during the trip and sent them to us afterwards.
title: Definitely Recommend

body: We booked this tour last minute and Buddhi was super accommodating, even helping to arrange an early morning tuktuk ride from our hotel. He is a very knowledgeable guide and made the tour a lot of fun and very comfortable. We saw dozens of species in the short amount of time we had! He was really kind to take many photos of us and provide them after the tour.
title: Awesome morning!

body: Excellent trip, fantastic experience and a very knowledgeable guide, really great experience, the place is so peaceful and quiet, a bird's paradise to watch
title: Fantastic trip

body: We visited this sanctuary in november.though it was not the season for flamingos there were still a wide variety of birds that could be seen.Our guide Buddhi was very passionate n really knew his job well.sharp boy n I was surprised how he could differentiate between the birds by looking at position of their wings.his family welcomed us with a local drink n his mother was kind enough to even give me the local fruit,that I had never had before.he even played flute for us.to sum up it was a beautiful visit which was made even more interesting by Buddhi
title: Beautiful experience n special thanks to Buddhi our guide

body: We fancied doing something a little different whilst on the South Coast of Sri Lanka, and a bird-watching tour seemed like a good thing to try. We couldn’t be happier with our choice - the trip was both enjoyable and educational, and our tour guide, Buddhi, was extremely friendly. We got up at 5am to take a tuk tuk (at 05.30am) from Tangalle to the location of the tour, in Kalametiya. The tuk tuk driver was organised by Buddhi, and he was super friendly (he even gave us some free tea on the way). Buddhi’s passion for the birds was very evident, which certainly rubbed off on us too. Buddhi was also happy to answer any questions we had.Moreover, this is more than just a birdwatching tour. Halfway through the trip, we got out of the boat and climbed to the top of a rock which looked out over the water. The views are incredible. Free snacks and drinks were provided too.I strongly recommend this trip for anyone who’s interested in birdwatching. But I also recommend the trip for anyone who just wants to do something different and experience the beauty of Sri Lanka.
title: Fantastic trip, great tour guide

body: The Eco Bird Watching Tour is a great option when staying in Tangalle. Buddhi was fantastic and arranged transportation right from our hotel. The tour was amazing and well worth the value. We did the 6am tour, which was early but worth it in my opinion, especially to avoid the heat. My favourite part was the hike up the rock to look out over the water. Buddhi also took many really nice photos and emailed them to us after.If you’re in Tangalle, it’s definitely worth the trip!
title: Great outing from Tangalle

body: It was a fantastic experience that we met 50 different types of birds :) People There are so nice And friendly! I recommend to visit!:))
title: Best choice!

body: Amazing tour around the lagoon.The guidance was really good. We are here maybe 3 hours on the boat. We are so excited!
title: Nice trip

body: It's really amazing enjoyment!! These guys were very sympathetic and have a lots of experiance! We saw maybe 50 types of birds:) It is really good choise!♥️♥️♥️ Thank you♥️
title: Eco bird watching

body: A lovely trip on the lake with our young, but well informed and enthusiastic, guide. So many different species of birds to be seen. Bring your camera if you have one. Buddhi has a powerful pair of binoculars which allows you to get the most out of the trip. We went at the end of the day and watched the sunset from the middle of the lake. Go now whilst it is still so beautiful and unspoilt.
title: Beautiful unspoilt lake

body: All the glowing reviews are true!! Many tour operators almost make you feel obliged to write them a TA review as they get some bonus from it; but I’m writing this review solely because Buddhi does such a fantastic tour and is truly deserving of all the praise.We were a family of 2 seniors, 2 tweens and 2 adults doing his morning tour. We only saw one other boat out on the lake and about 40 birds. Buddhi provided us with quality binoculars to use which thrilled the kids to no end.He has eagle eyes and can spot so many birds, even one 12cm one from our boat!Biscuits and water was provided which was great as we were hungry by midway having set out so early.Extra fun included in the climb up to the rock top. I’d do this tour again when I revisit Sri Lanka!! Don’t miss it!
title: Best tour of our trip!

body: Had a beautiful and exiting experience at the bird santuary with very friendly hosting by Buddhi and team.
title: Beautiful sights and interesting facts

body: We had a lovely time on Buddhi’s bird tour. Before we even got on the boat we saw about 6 different birds! The boat ride was very special and was very peaceful. Buddhi’s bird knowledge was incredible and as well as pointing out the birds he then showed us pictures in a bird book too. He provided water and yummy biscuits and umbrellas - it started raining about half way through the tour but that just added to the adventure for us / he covered our bags and played the flute while we moved around the water in the misty rain. We have now bought two flutes to learn to play! (Buddhi provided us with the music store location). Buddhi also organised tuk tuk’s for us to get to the bird sanctuary and we had a very cool driver. A great day and we all had a fantastic time!
title: Amazing bird tour while on a lovely boat ride with friendly and knowledgeable host Buddhi

body: For someone who loves birds, this is of one the best places to go when you stay in the South of Sri Lanka and if you yourself are an early bird. It is recommendable to be there at 6 am. The bird sanctuary is not crowded like the nearby nationalparks. A big plus is that you have the perspective from the water. If you are lucky it is a tranquil peaceful tour unless you have the noice from the subwoofers from a nearby hotel. Buddhi is an exellent guide. He has a fundamental knowledge of all the species. Further more he is a very friendly and nice guy, and a musician too , playing the flute at the and of the tour. We enjoyed beeing with him on that tour very much and would book him again.Klaus &Hansjoerg, Switzerland
title: A birds paradise

body: After rushing around Sri Lanka it was wonderful to have a few hours floating on the lagoon with such a charming knowledgeable guide Buddhi.We saw 48 different species of birds and were provided with water and biscuits. Just perfect.
title: Beautiful tranquil bird spotting

body: A beautiful trip around the lagoon with our young guide BuddhiLots of birds and expert guidanceDon’t go with anyone else He’s the best

You drift around this amazing lagoon with his expert guidance and we saw around 50 species in 2 hours. Even if you aren't a birder it is fantastic. title: Bird watching

body: We went on the morning tour with Buddhi and his colleagues and it was AMAZING, definitely a highlight of our holiday in Sri Lanka. We were really impressed by Buddhi's knowledge about birds and love for nature. Plus, it is a beautiful national park, very peaceful and full of wildlife. I highly recommend this tour, you will not be disappointed.
title: Amazing tour

body: Budhi is an amazing, enthusiastic and energetic guide. He is not only very knowledgeable on the bird life and the wetland eco system but is totally passionate about it and is totally committed to preserve it and keep it pristine! The ride itself is about 2-3 hrs depending on how long you want to go. It is amazing to be out in the lagoon early in the morning or later in the evening to see the sun rise or set. The biodiversity and birdlife is amazing. To see it through Budhi's enthusiastic eyes and smile is certainly a fun experience! Definitely worth the time and value. The 360 view from Taragala rock is lovely and definitely worth a climb!We loved every aspect of Budhi's tour and found him very professional, compassionate and reliable. We will be back every time we are in Kalametiya. Highly recommend it to anyone in the area with a love for the outdoors or nature!
title: "Budhi Kalmatiya Eco birdwatching" safari in Kalametiya!

body: We visited here in September and nearly cancelled because of the heavy downpour before we arrived. We're so glad we didn't. It was truly one of the highlights of the holiday. We floated past nearly 40 types of different birds.Near the end of the trip, as we alighted briefly on the land,we were treated to a show of fruit bats landing nearby in the mango trees. Our guide was very knowledgeable and keen to help us see all the bird life as it came in to roost. This is a very special place. If you like to see bird life in its natural surrounding this is a must on any holiday itinerary.
title: A Sri Lankan gem

body: We did the tour yesterday morning with Buddhi and really enjoyed it. Buddhi is a very kind and funny guy and really well trained in spotting birds no matter how far they are away. We could hardly turn our heads that fast :) But at least we saw 55 different species and even 2 rare ones, as Buddhi told us. It was a great experience in a stunning surrounding and Buddhi has a very detailled knowledge of all the different birds in that area. He even brought two very good binoculars and bird books with him, which really helped us during the tour. Overall the tour is very recommendable!Thanks Buddhi for doing that tour with us and being very patient in explaining the positions of the birds, even we couldn't see them always directly... ;)
title: Great tour in stunning nature!

body: We had a brilliant day with Buddhi, his brother and cousin, really enjoyed every minute and I know nothing about bird watching! The passion they have to share their knowledge is fantastic and they want you to learn and see as much as possible, put this along side the fact they were so welcoming and warm and it really was a great day!
title: One of my best experiances in Sri Lanka

body: As an adult family of 7 we thoroughly enjoyed this experience - it was one of the highlights of our two week stay in Sri Lanka and we are in no way bird watchers! Buddhi and his brother were fantastic guides and we saw 40+ different species whilst being paddled around the beautiful waterways as the sun set. The climb up the rock was fab - a definitely spiritual place. Very highly recommended if you love nature, want to get off the beaten track and are into sustainable tourism - a really genuine experience. Thanks Buddhi for some wonderful memories:)BTW I think the previous reviewer must have been talking about something else!
title: Awesome experience

title: Amazing Experience

body: We had a lovely time, saw lots of birds. Buddhi is a top bloke and very knowledgeable. Would strongly recommend
title: Great experience

title: Simply amazing!!
