title: Trip to Kalametiya Bird Santuary

body: We started our tour at 3:30pm which is perfect to catch the sunset from the viewpoint there. We saw over 30 different species of birds. The guides were very knowledgable and super friendly. They don’t use petrol engines and really care about preserving the area. Bhuddi and his team were amazing! Would recommend to anyone who loves animals and nature or just a fun trip :)
title: Amazing trip with lovely people

body: Decided to sign up for the bird watching tour and was not disappointed even though it was an off peak season for the birds (especially since there aren’t many migratory birds).My boat was led by Buddhi’s cousin, who was really patient and attentive. He explained to me elk and answered my questions. It was nice being out in the morning for the sunrise - only a couple of boats, and with the serenity and birds chirping. Overall, I enjoyed the tour. But what’s even more outstanding was my post- tour experience with Buddhi! My taxi ride was only going to come 2-3 hours after my tour ended and Buddhi was kind enough to let me hang around at his place, which is in the same area. I spent the next 3 hours chatting with Buddhi and his brother, and they served me fruits, drinks etc. this wasn’t even necessary but they were just so kind!! Your hospitality is outstanding Buddhi.
title: Great experience - not too crowded and touristy. Recommended!

body: Buddhi was very knowledgable and enthusiastic. We all learned loads and saw 47 different types of birds! He supplied good quality binoculars and we got lots of great pictures. It was a very eco-friendly tour the raft was rowed around slowly so as to not disturb the wildlife. Highly recommended for the whole family.
title: A beautiful peaceful location

body: We had an awesome guide - Buddhi, who loves birds and knows a lot of them. Moreover, he could see them everywhere. Buddhi equipped us with binoculars and we were able to see the smallest birds and their baby birds. The funniest part was climbing the rock - it has very good views. In total, we have seen 38 birds, some with baby birds in 2 hours thanks to our guide!
title: Boat trip

body: We spent a beautiful afternoon at the Kalametiya lagoon viewing a multitude of birds by boat with Buddhi, our host, who expertly pointed out birds of all shapes and sizes in and around the lagoon. He provided binoculars for us to use and we traveled on a quiet boat around the lagoon, powered only by his friendly crew using poles. We highly recommend this tour for anyone who loves nature and special places. It was the perfect way to round out our trip to Sri Lanka. We also left with some amazing bird photos. Not to be missed!
title: Special tour of the beautiful Kalametiya lagoon

body: If you are into animals this is a must do! We booked a morning trip, arrived at 6am and at 6:15am we were on the boat. Buddhi and 2 other friends/guides were the most friendly people we have met so far and especially Buddhi really knew what he was talking about. After a few minutes on the water we already saw a lot of really nice birds and Buddhi kept on pointing to them, they were everywhere! Also they told us a lot about the background of the lagoon and how the Tsunami in 2004 changed the scenery around there. In total we saw around 55 species of birds. I can’t recommend this enough, go do this!
title: Awesome experience

body: We did a lot of things during our trip in Sri Lanka, but we didnt had a boattour to see the beatiful birds yet. We thought lets try it and enjoy nature. Wow! It was so quiet and so serene. Our guide Buddhi knows so much of all the birds. He always smiles and and is always super excited to tell us about the birds he spotted or the surroundings. It just gives you a smile on your face. In the middle of the tour buddhi asked if he could change boats with his brother so buddhi could share his enthousiasm also with a little birdwatcher on the other boat :). The brother was also super nice and always laughing. We loved that!!! We could even try to paddle ourselves through nature. Nice experience to do! The tour ended by climbing a big black rock, where we could see the whole surroundings from above. Just experience yourself!
title: Just makes you smile

body: You should make a point of taking a trip with Buddhi at this gem of a place. Even in the non-migratory season, we visited on 29th July'18, we still spotted well over 40 species of birds. Part of the safari was on a comfortable punt boat and part on foot on and around a rocky outcrop, mid voyage. All the time Buddhi points out birds of all types from great distances, just by eye sight, whilst we need our binoculars, though many of the birds are comfortable with us coming quite close, as the boat is so quiet, having no engine. Apparently, early mornings are slightly better for bird numbers, but we did an afternoon / evening trip and saw lots and enjoyed the setting sun over the lake and landscape. The price is very reasonable and the duration a good 3 hours and no rushing, and a local fisherman punts the boat whilst Buddhi concentrates on the tour. We are a family with two late teens boys, and they enjoyed the safari in equal measure. We only had one pair of binoculars of our own, but Buddhi lent us 3 other pairs, so we missed nothing. I suggest you do this as your second safari in Sri Lanka rather than going to two of the wildlife parks. Good English spoken by Buddhi, along with passionate info about the birds and the location, and a check list of the birds we saw, to take away. We booked ahead of time, by direct email, and all went very smoothly. Enjoy your visit!
title: Wonderful, relaxing, family experience

body: This was one of the places that I was planning to visit for a long time since I am into Bird & wildlife photography. It was a sudden plan to spend the long weekend in Tangalle. I called Buddhi before the trip made a reservation for a boat ride on the 2nd day morning. Kalametiya bird sanctuary resides near the hotel that we planned our family weekend stay.It was 30 min drive from the hotel and we were there sharp at 6 am as planned. My wife and my 3 year old daughter joined with me for the ride including Buddhi and the boat rider.The place was amazing and it was our first ride on a catamaran. Our guide Buddhi was so informative and he brought us the binoculars, water and biscuits too. It was cool and little bit of breeze and was a very nice experience.We spent around 3 hrs in the boat and climbed a rock also to get an amazing view of this paradise. Buddhi was very informative with so many experience knowing the names of all the birds and where those birds can be seen. Not only that he helped us by carrying our daughter also when we climbed the rock and he showed us how to eat pathok fruit. Even though it was off season we still managed to spot more than 50 birds and I am happy that I manage to get some good photos. I highly recommend Buddhi as the guide and also this place for any Nature or Bird lover.
title: Amazing experience at Kalametiya

body: Indian darters, herons, ibis, egrets, sea eagle and even a hawk eagle to mention just a few. Seen on a quiet boat moved by pole, it was lovely and I got some fantastic bird in flight photos.
title: fantastic birds up close

body: This was an absolute highlight of my trip to Sri Lanka. Buddhi, like me, is really passionate about birds and it was wonderful to spend three hours out on this beautiful stretch of water seeing so many birds including painted storks, pied, common, white-throated and stork kingfishers, even a redshank. In all we saw 57 species - in the low season. He was a great guide and took us all around the lake on a punt pushed by his colleague. He also had great high quality spare binoculars. If you are in Kalaymetiya go with Buddhi to see the birds.
title: Wonderful trip with Buddhi

body: This was not part of our itinerary until we stumbled across the reviews on tripadvisor. And thought it would be a good morning stop off from Tangelle to Yala, and we weren’t disappointed. Buddhi greeted us, and even offered to look after our big bags whilst we went on the tour. The conservation area is 500m from his house, and is well worth the walk as Buddhi started spotting birds immediately. We were provided with binoculars, biscuits, water bottles. And Buddhi had a number of bird books with him for reference, although his knowledge of the bird species impressed us. The conservation area is unspoilt and although it was out of season we spotted 48 species of bird and some monkeys. Great tour, great experience and great guide!
title: Birds, binoculars and biscuits

body: This is a hidden gem of Sri Lanka, the perfect place to experience the beautiful birds with out the humdrum of jeep engines. Located on a peaceful lagoon, we travelled the tranquil waters and bore witness to an aviary. There was a plethora of different birds, an absolute birders paradise. Painted Stork, Spot-billed Pelicans and even several glimpses of the rare Black Bittern. Buddhi knows his birds and nature, he truly enjoy his vocation and shares his knowledge and expertise with you. I have to admit a bit of envy at him having such a beautiful spot as an “office”. Buddhi challenged us to count how many different species we saw, we failed miserably; there was just too many!We would truly recommend this place to anyone who wants to see the beauty of Sri Lanka's wildlife in an intimate and non invasive way.
title: Picture Perfect, Hidden Gem!

body: Udawalaweからふらっと立ち寄りましたが、期待以上です！ガイドのBuddiさんはとても真面目な方で、豊富な知識に驚かされました。鳥だけではなく特異な地形をボートに乗りながら楽しめたり、大きな岩の上に登り、360度ジャングルのパノラマに沈む夕日が感動的。ここでしかできない、ここでしか見れないものに沢山出会えます。是非一度訪れてみて下さい。We stopped by the place from udawalawe national park to galle. Even though the experience that we had at the national park was unforgettably awesome, literally Buddi's given epic moment which was beyond our expectation. Enjoyed geographically treasured landscape and birds all the way around the river. Ending with majestic sunset went down the jungles with silence made me impressed. 200 percent worth to recommend.
title: Unpredictably fantastic

body: We had a wonderful, peaceful morning, gliding across the glassy water, brushing through reeds, surrounded by stillness and the sounds of birds distant and near - sometimes with the addition of Buddhi's flute. title: Amazing experience

body: We saw over 50 different bird species during our 3 hour trip. Buddhi our guide was very knowledgeable and adept at spotting even well hidden birds. Our raft was stable and comfortable. Overall a great birding experience.
title: Morning bird watching

body: This was an extended family tour of the south coast including birdwatching in Yala and Bundala parks. Despite having seen a good number of wetland birds already we managed to clock up a few more on Buddhi's highly enjoyable excursion round the beautiful lagoon at Kalimatiya, handy to walk to from our hotel (Turtle Bay). Even if you are not a bird watcher this is a relaxing and interesting trip which we would highly recommend. Buddhi and his colleague who steered the boat provided us with a great insight into the wetland area and he has an enthusiastic love of the area as well as good knowledge of the local wildlife. Booking and communication with Buddhi was excellent and efficient. If you are in the area and you enjoy the scenery and bird life in this special environment contact Buddhi and let him take you in his unique tour!
title: Excellent afternoon if birdwatching in this stunning location

body: This is a peaceful, simple and affordable afternoon out if you’re on the south coast. We knew nothing about birds and were mostly looking forward to the time on the boat and the views. We got all of this plus new knowledge of about 40 species of birds. Our instructor was so keen it was infectious. Highly recommended.
title: Joyous

body: This trip was definitely one of the most beautiful, pleasant and inspiring experiences during our wonderful stay in Sri Lanka. While perhaps a little bit off the beaten tourist track this is also what makes this trip so special. It was a quiet and almost meditative experience accompanied by sounds of nature - no engine involved. To enjoy this trip you don't have to consider yourself a bird watching specialist. We are not at least, but have a general interest in nature and wildlife and we saw a lot of interesting birds on this trip. Our guide was so nice and enthusiastic and even helped our kids climb a rock to view the sunset. Thank you Buddhi!
title: Truly unique experience

body: Just to confirm what other reviews say. The kalamatiya birds sanctuary is a great place for watching the lagoon wildlife. title: What a great place for bird watching

body: You do not have to be a twitcher to enjoy this wonderful 2 hour experience of tranquility. Mahesh our guide was very knowledgeable and friendly pointing out over 40 different species of bird along with monkeys and water buffalo. Thank you also to the gentleman doing the hard work punting us around the lagoon. A must do.
title: Wonderful tranquil trip around a peaceful lagoon.

body: It's an unbelievably beautiful place! This comforting silence... you only hear the birds singing. I had a private boattour. The guide and the "engin" of the paddle-boat were really nice and showed me A LOT of different kinds of birds, the guide knew what they eat and how they hunt. He always showed me pictures on his phone when the bird was too far away to look at closely. They stopped everywhere they thought that there could be a species that I haven't seen yet. They offered me water and cookies.And there was only one other boat in this big lagoon. Noone else. Only some waterbuffalows, some monkeys playing in the trees and shy crocodiles who didn't want to show themselves. You really should go there if you like the nature and the natural silent peace. I LOVED IT!!!
title: Beyond words.

body: Our Sri Lanka tour finished by three days in Ranna and we discovered this bird place into our guide book.We did visit many birds places and wanted to see this one but we did not expect much.Thanks to Buddhi who organized a tuktuk pickup from our hotel we arrived on time for an almost three hour tour starting from 3:30 pm. After having a refreshing fruit juice in Buddi home place we started the visit. We boarded on a small boat with our guide Buddi and a boat paddler.Once on the boat we crossed the laguna and entered into another world. We saw hundred of birds. They were everywhere.Overall we saw 47 different birds species. as well as buffalos, varans, monkeys. The sunset on the water with birds on the back of water buffalos was outstanding. You could stay a whole day in this paradise where the time seems to have stopped.The laguna is wide and very quiet. You will listen only the birds music and the sound of the water made by the paddle.Buddhi is a bird lover and he is a pationate person. He is dedicated to nature and birds. He made this visit the best birds watching we never had. We were amazed by the amount of birds we saw. Most of the time in these kind of visit you see some few birds very far away. Here you are surrounded by birds. They are everywhere just few meters away. You do not need expensive camera with long focal lenses to take nice birds photos.Surprisingly a small fish attacked by an heron jumped on the bench on which I was sitting and it was not a flying fish.My wife, who is not mad of birds as I am, came with me and was not expecting to discover such an amazing place.She went in love with the beauty and the peacefulness of the laguna.The end of the trip was accompanied by the music played by Buddhi on his flute and this added a 48th bird to our visit.We warmly want to thank Buddhi for permitting us to discover this magical place.If you are in Tangalle area this is the place you have to visit.
title: An out of the world and time place

body: Just to say how much we enjoyed our birdwatching tour with you - you are a very special person in a very special place You are a fine young man with star quality - you have a wonderful delightful and catching personality an excellent communicator with a gentle caring natureYou are wellsuited to work in such a serene and peaceful setting with you respect for all aspects of nature and your environmental awarenessWe feel very fortunate to have you as our guide Your enthusiasm and passion is very catchingYour knowledge of birds is unparalleled and your all seeing eyes and ability to identify birds close and from a far so quickly is quite amazing - in fact through you we were able to see 45 different species Remember knowledge is power - no one can take that away from youTo be honest you are one of the most impressionable young men we have met in our two visits to Sri Lanka and I do not say that lightlyYou deserve huge successIt was a pleasure to assist you with a pair of binoculars - you learnt the hard way but now you will gain even more knowledge as you will be able to identify the more finer details and characteristics of the birdsThis must be one of the most beautiful birds sancturies in the world for many reasonsWe can only strongly recommend you contact Buddhi on mobile +94 71 355 79 25 for a unique experience of a lifetimeSee you next year
title: Amazing Buddhi

title: Great Bird Watching with guide Buddhi

body: This Tour is the best to see a lot of birds of Sri Lanka in a wonderful nature with a great Guide. We saw 60 different birds and heard some others more during our 3-hour boat Trip. Thank you Buddhi for such a great experience.

body: We had a fantastic afternoon travelling around the lagoon and our guide Buddhi was passionate and incredibly knowlegable about the different birds in the area. title: Fabulous, peaceful visit

body: After a drive into what felt like the middle of nowhere we were greeted by Buddhi at 6 in the morning and headed out for a very enjoyable two and a half hours out on what was a millpond smooth estuary. This was one of the highlights of our trip to Sri Lanka and we wouldn’t hesitate to recommend it to anyone.
title: A fabulous experience

body: This is a must do for nature lovers visiting the Tangalle area. The lagoon is vast, beautiful, peaceful and full of life. We spent a leisurely couple of hours being expertly guided on a noiseless catamaran and saw lots of different birds. Even without the natural interest this is a lovely thing to do just before sunset - a stunning experience.
title: A wonderful experience - serene, beautiful and informative

body: Really loved driving to this spot in the middle of paradise.Lovely walk up a rock to a spectacular view!Not a lot of birds,but landscape that is breathtaking.Help from a local farmer was much appreciated! As he steered his water buffalo away from us.
title: Such a hidden gem! With a small hike to a little rock! Perfect

body: Buddhi was very friendly and has got a wealth of knowledge about all the birds and the swamp. The boat trip is the most enjoyable of all. My kids enjoyed a lot. Up on the rock panoramic views were fantastic. Thanks again for the hospitality.
title: Best of the best bird watching tour ever
great view and lots of silence
body: paddling down the quit river was pretty nice.we may not have seen a lot on the first halve of the tour but near the end the sanctuary really started to come to life.pelicans,darters,herons,a stork or 2,godwits,spoonbills and ibisses.really worth it

title: Superb tranquil lagoon teeming with burdlife
body: How delighted we were when our hosts at the charming Asha Beach and Spa accomodation, Tangalle suggested a dawn visit to the lagoon. The guide is excellent and does a great job pointing out the birds. An unexpected treat was a little treat of cookies made by his mother. This experience is highly recommended and you do not have to be a twitcher to enjoy.

title: A really interesting and relaxing trip
body: We had the most amazing time spotting birds and relaxing on the boat with Buddhi, our guide. Buddhi was great. He was very kind and smiley and he provided biscuits and water for us. We saw such amazing wildlife and we learnt a lot from Buddhi. We recommend this amazing experience, it was the highlight of our trip.

title: Buddhi is the best in kalametiya..
body: Started the tour @ 3.30pm with my italian friends and Buddhi. Buddhi knows about kalametiya well. We enjoyed the tour well. We saw gray herons, king fishers, pelicans, wisling ducks, purple swamp hen, oriyantal darts, comerents, etc. we climbed kema rock middle in the kalametiya bird sanctuary. I recommend this is the best place for bird watching in sri lanka.

title: A great afternoon relaxing in the sun
body: We loved our afternoon with Buddhi drifting around the bird sanctuary and spotting the local birdlife. Buddhi was such a smiling, happy and welcoming host, and he made a special effort to keep our children entertained too. Thank you!

title: Don't have to know birds well to enjoy it
body: My wife and I don't have much of a combined knowledge of birds, but we figured "why not?" when our hotel offered the tour. We had read about the sanctuary, and we figured it would be a neat experience to see something like that. The boat ride was really peaceful, and the guide was very sharp at pointing out various birds and some monkeys. There is an absolutely plethora of birds, quite the variety really. I don't remember how long the whole trip was, but we were out for a while, and I think we saw a lot more than we imagined. My only regret was forgetting my lens that zoomed in much closer.
